entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the item you're looking to return?
The name's Sam Jones. It's for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor.
Okay, thanks, Sam. I see the order here. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no 'issue'. I just changed my mind.
I understand. Sometimes there are features that aren't immediately obvious. Are you having trouble with tracking, or perhaps the fit?
No. I just don't use it. It was an impulse buy.

I appreciate the honesty. Let me pull up the specific return policy for the VeloBand Pulse. One moment... Okay, I see your band was delivered 17 days ago. Because this is a health device that activates and syncs personal data to an account, it has a strict 10-day return window. Since we're past that window, I'm unable to process a refund.
Ten days. Of course. That's very convenient for you.
I do understand the frustration, Sam. And while a direct return to us isn't possible, I do have a popular alternative I can offer.
What?

We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a secure platform for owners to sell their gently used gear to other VeloFit enthusiasts. Since the product is barely used, it's a great option for resale and you can often get most of your money back.
So I have to sell it myself. Great.

We provide the verified platform to make it easy and safe. It's much more effective than a general site because the buyers are already looking for VeloFit products. I can send you a direct link with instructions right now.
Fine. Whatever. Send the link.
Okay, the email has been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, Sam. Have a good rest of your day.
